patch_description: This crossover version combines the stronger parts of the prior scripts while focusing on the main failure mode: slope collapse on the validation regime. I kept the feature set compact and more regime-invariant by emphasizing shorter lookbacks, rolling z-scores, volatility and autocorrelation trends, and momentum × volatility interactions. The XGBoost configuration is made slightly less brittle than the current program by reducing extreme learning rate / depth while restoring enough model capacity to avoid mean-collapse. Feature count is kept well under the limit, and all features use only past data.
